name: Reqme – AI-Powered Service Management
author: Reqme

sections.description:
Reqme turns your WordPress website into an intelligent service management hub that simplifies every touchpoint in your client journey from first contact to final payment.

Stop losing leads due to delayed responses and complex processes. The Reqme WordPress plugin adds AI-powered service management to your site, automatically classifying incoming client requests, helping you respond faster, and guiding your clients smoothly through your service process.

Key Features

🤖 AI-Powered Request Management on WordPress

  • Smart request classification and prioritization directly on your WordPress site
  • Automated response system integrated with your existing website
  • WordPress-friendly interface for managing client requests

📱 Centralized Communication Hub

  • All client messages from your WordPress site in one place
  • Real-time notifications for new requests
  • Complete communication history with your website visitors

📊 Service Management Dashboard

  • Track WordPress client request status and progress
  • Monitor interactions from your site visitors
  • Manage all service requests from your WordPress website in one place

💳 Integrated Payment Processing

  • Accept payments directly through your WordPress site
  • Generate invoices automatically
  • Track payment status from web requests

📝 Document Automation

  • Share contracts, invoices and project documents for your WordPress clients
  • Store all client documents securely

Why Choose Reqme for WordPress?

  • Save Time: Reduce response time from hours to minutes
  • Increase Conversions: Boost conversion rates on your WordPress site by 20-30%
  • Cut Costs: Reduce operational costs by up to 30%
  • Improve Experience: Provide a seamless client experience through your website
  • Simple Setup: No technical skills required – install the WordPress plugin and start using in minutes

Perfect For WordPress Businesses

  • Service-based small and medium businesses with WordPress sites
  • Professional service providers using WordPress
  • Digital agencies managing client websites
  • WordPress-based service businesses
  • Consultants and freelancers with WordPress presence

Join WordPress businesses already transforming their client service experience with Reqme.

External Service Notice

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Reqme platform (https://reqme.co) via the Reqme API. When you use this plugin, the following data may be sent to Reqme servers:

  • API key (entered by you in plugin settings)
  • Client request details submitted via your website (such as contact information, service requests, and messages)
  • Payment and document data if you use those features

Data is transmitted securely over HTTPS. For details on how your data is handled, please review:

  • Reqme Privacy Policy: https://reqme.co/privacy
  • Reqme Terms of Service: https://reqme.co/terms

You must agree to these terms to use the Reqme service. No data is sent to Reqme until you connect your site using your API key.
sections.installation:
Quick Start Guide:

  1. Install the Plugin

    • Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
    • Search for “Reqme” or upload the plugin zip file
    • Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

  2. Connect Your Reqme Account

    • Navigate to “Reqme” in your WordPress admin menu
    • Click on the “Authorization” tab
    • You’ll need a Reqme API key to connect (don’t have one? See step 3)

  3. Get Your API Key

    • Click “Register for Reqme” within the plugin
    • Complete the registration and onboarding process on the Reqme website
    • Your API key will be provided after onboarding process in your Company category
    • Copy this key and return to your WordPress dashboard

  4. Enter Your API Key

    • Paste your API key in the Authorization section
    • Click “Connect” to link your WordPress site with your Reqme account

  5. Configure Settings

    • Go to the “Settings” tab in the Reqme plugin
    • Adjust the appearance and behavior of Reqme on your website
    • Save your settings

  6. Start Managing Requests

    • Begin receiving and processing client requests through your new system
    • Access the Reqme dashboard to manage all client communications

For detailed instructions and troubleshooting, please visit our documentation at https://reqme.co.
sections.faq:
Is Reqme free to use?

Yes, Reqme offers a free plan with limited features. For businesses needing more capabilities, premium plans are available. Visit our website for detailed pricing information.

What kind of WordPress businesses can benefit from Reqme?

Any service-based business with a WordPress website that receives client requests can benefit from Reqme. This includes consultants, agencies, professional service providers, and other businesses that need to manage client communications and service delivery.

Does Reqme integrate with WordPress contact forms?

Yes, Reqme can work alongside your existing WordPress forms or replace them with our smart request management system.

Does Reqme integrate with payment processors?

Yes, Reqme integrates with popular payment processors, allowing you to accept payments directly through your WordPress site via Reqme request.

How does the AI request classification work?

Our AI automatically analyzes incoming requests to determine their type, overview, and required action. This helps you respond faster and more effectively to client needs, all within your WordPress ecosystem.

Can I configure Reqme to match my WordPress theme?

Yes, Reqme provides configuration options so you can adjust the appearance and settings to complement your WordPress theme and meet your specific business requirements.

Is my data secure with Reqme?

Yes, Reqme takes data security seriously. All data is encrypted, and we follow industry best practices for security and privacy. The plugin communicates securely with our servers.

Does Reqme work with my existing WordPress theme?

Yes, Reqme is designed to work seamlessly with any WordPress theme. The plugin adapts to your site’s design while maintaining functionality.

Will Reqme slow down my WordPress site?

No, Reqme is optimized for performance and loads resources asynchronously to ensure your WordPress site remains fast and responsive.
